title: 50agents vs Gumloop: AI agent builders compared | 50agents
description: 50agents vs Gumloop: Gumloop is a team AI agent builder from $37 a month after a trial; 50agents starts free and builds automations, AI agents and apps.
answer: Pick Gumloop for team AI agents with IT controls and a cloud browser you can watch.
Pick 50agents to start free and get browser agents, AI agents and apps from plain words.
line: Browser agents, AI agents and apps from plain words, free to start.
ask: Set up a browser agent that checks my competitors' pricing pages every day at 9:00 and tells me when a price changes
lede: Two AI agent builders, row by row.

faqs.q: Does 50agents have a browser agent like Gumloop?
faqs.a: Yes. 50agents browser agents read and use websites with no app to connect, on a schedule.
50agents is free to start. Gumloop has no free plan; its 14-day Pro trial needs a card.
Gumloop lists 100+ MCP integrations. 50agents works with 2,300+ apps through viaSocket.
50agents is free to start. Gumloop has a 14-day Pro trial that needs a card, then Pro is $37 a month for 20,000 credits.

faqs.q: Which suits a job on a logged-in website?
faqs.a: Gumloop's AI agent browser has a credential vault with saved logins. 50agents browser agents run on a schedule, leave a report, and need your OK to log in.

faqs.q: Can I move my Gumloop AI agents over?
faqs.a: There is no import. Note what each one does, then describe it to Captain, which shows a plan before it builds.
No. Steps are fixed blocks. Gumloop has a code sandbox.
